## Notes

Solar sails fired by EM-Rail Ejectors give 36 kW base scaled by star luminosity and last 5,400 s by default; Small Carrier Rockets from Vertical Launching Silos build frames; completed shells absorb swarm sails permanently; Ray Receivers start at 30% efficiency and can make critical photons.
